verification_report.summary: All proof items pass under the stated accepted inputs. The tail-inf/upper-envelope closure uses only finite-max ordered contact, genuine-barrier monotone capacity convergence, and two damped passages, so no finite undamped-mass assertion is smuggled in. The greatest normalized threshold subsolution is compact and is not claimed to solve the equation. In the conditional theorem, the smooth maximizing sequence and first-moment hypothesis give the scalar bound by the trace inequality and Jensen; the genuine smaller-background envelope and the lower barrier then give capacity convergence. Only after that convergence does damped continuity yield MA_ext(v)=bf dV and hence finiteness. The final L^q and bounded-envelope sufficient conditions are valid and are correctly stated as additional hypotheses. No direct external-paper citation occurs in the candidate proof.
